purpose: Validate task admission, oracle quality, experimental controls, evidence receipts, metrics and budget accounting for a Rust repository-repair pilot. This pilot is not designed or powered to establish state-of-the-art superiority.

permitted_now: gold patch and oracle review without executing candidate code
prohibited_now: claiming isolated execution or independent pristine regrade

inclusion_criteria: Publicly licensed Rust repository with a frozen source commit and documented task provenance.
Issue is reproducible from a clean source snapshot under a pinned supported toolchain after runner qualification.
Acceptance criteria describe observable behavior and are independently adjudicable.
A reference patch exists or independent reviewers can author and validate an equivalent gold repair.
Reference-patch and empty-patch controls can be evaluated after isolation qualification.
Task is not trivially solved by a publicly visible fix commit, leaked test, benchmark-specific prompt or ambient network retrieval.
exclusion_criteria: Unresolvable dependency, missing license provenance or unstable external service dependency.
Oracle relies solely on an LLM judge.
Task cannot be replayed from the frozen source and environment.
Task execution requires secrets, production access or destructive external side effects.
Unresolved disagreement between independent gold reviewers.

task_custody.holdout_access: held outside the agent workspace and revealed only after task and grader revisions, hashes, resource budgets and analysis plan are committed
task_custody.note: The 16-task holdout is a pilot feasibility check, not a sufficient sample for a broad superiority claim.

baseline_arms.description: Deterministic compiler, formatter, linter, static analysis and repository search where applicable.
One pinned foundation model with a minimal agent harness.
The same foundation model with a strong conventional coding-agent harness.
The same model and strong harness plus exactly one preregistered Symthaea component.
Symthaea-native path only on tasks where the system can attempt the task without a frontier foundation model; report as a separate arm.
Blind expert-human reference arm with recorded experience, time and review protocol; do not mix human results into agent seed counts.
Separate complementarity arm measuring review time, interventions, accepted repair and defect recall.

resource_matching.model: same pinned model and dated API/model identifier across the paired agent arms
resource_matching.harness: hold fixed except for the explicitly named harness/component ablation
resource_matching.deviation_policy: Any deviation is recorded per task and removes that task from the matched comparison unless the preregistered analysis explicitly supports the deviation.

primary_endpoint.name: accepted_regression_safe_repair_rate
primary_endpoint.definition: Share of admitted tasks for which the candidate patch satisfies issue-specific fail-to-pass checks, preserves all qualified pass-to-pass contracts, passes independent review and has no critical security or authorization failure.
primary_endpoint.rule: Invalid, unresolved, unqualified, abstained and escalated tasks remain visible as separate dispositions; do not silently drop them from coverage or score denominators.

oracle_qualification.disagreement_resolution: third independent adjudicator; unresolved tasks excluded from candidate scoring but retained in the admission report
required_pre_execution_controls: reference patch expected to satisfy acceptance contract
empty patch expected to fail issue-specific contract
task instructions reviewed independently of implementation diff

statistics.paired_analysis: Compare the same admitted task across arms. Report paired effect sizes, discordant outcomes and exact task-level denominators.
statistics.uncertainty: Use paired confidence intervals; supplement with repository/root-cause-clustered bootstrap sensitivity analysis. Do not treat multiple seeds on one task as independent tasks.
statistics.sample_size: Use pilot discordance and cluster variance to calculate the confirmatory sample size; do not claim 80% power or superiority from the 48-task pilot without that calculation.
statistics.multiplicity: Name one primary arm contrast and one primary endpoint before opening the 16-task holdout; treat all other comparisons as exploratory.
statistics.missingness: Timeouts, budget exhaustion, refusals, abstentions and ungraded tasks are reported; no silent complete-case filtering.

preregistered_contrasts.question: Does the selected Symthaea component improve accepted regression-safe repair under matched model, harness and budget?
How much value comes from conventional harness engineering before attributing benefit to Symthaea?
Does agent assistance improve defect detection or reduce review time without lowering accepted quality?

stopping_rules: Stop a task immediately if isolation, authorization or secret-boundary controls fail.
Invalidate and quarantine a task when reference-patch or empty-patch qualification fails.
Stop the pilot if task identity, source digest, grader digest or evidence custody cannot be reconstructed.
Do not change primary endpoint, task exclusions or budgets after holdout access; issue a new preregistration version instead.

mandatory: paired effect sizes and confidence intervals
reporting.claim_ceiling: Pilot feasibility and descriptive findings only. No direct SOTA, causal component benefit or independent qualification claim without matched design, sufficient power and the appropriate infrastructure gates.
